newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Central Bank eyes Japanese, UK markets.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Central Bank eyes Japanese, UK markets.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank said it received a report from Japanese consultants on the prospects for issuing debt in Japan and it was also interested in the British market.
"The Central Bank asked a Japanese consulting company to sound out the market with the possibility of launching bonds. That report was handed to us today," a bank spokesman said.
He said the bank was interested in a euroyen issue and a British-sterling denominated issue in the future, but added no details had yet been decided.
The spokesman denied rumors the bank had already decided to issue debt in Japan and Britain.
"The only thing concrete is that we are interested," he said.
